verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.honeycomb.io (HTTP 200) that indexes Markdown versions of doc pages. The docs also ship agent-oriented content: .md page variants, an _llms/ section, and an agent-skills plugin that gives AI assistants observability workflows. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle.
